desc: Designed to perform a wide variety of functions on a wide variety of AK and other AK-type rifles. Nickel-plated finish for superior corrosion resistance. Heavy-duty design, made from 4140 steel for durability. Main body built to prevent flex and assist in loosening tough front sights. Long handle removable wrench provides excellent leverage to ease movement of the pusher. The body features a built-in pointer and markings on the pusher to track movement when adjusting windage and elevation. The handle includes a gas tube wrench, a handguard cap lever wrench, and multi-function nubs for muzzle brake detents or recoil button compression. Each hash mark adjusts bullet impact by approximately 1.0 MOA, depending on barrel length.
